title_zh: 准备康复就诊时要问的问题

scenario.label_zh: 为康复就诊准备恢复能力的提问
scenario.goal_zh: 明确希望恢复的具体能力并决定在就诊时询问进展判断方法

context_zh: 虚构健康沟通练习。Oliver 与朋友 Hana 准备向康复治疗师提问，不提供训练建议。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Oliver
sentences.text: My rehabilitation appointment is tomorrow, and I never know how to describe what I want to regain.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: What everyday activity matters most to you?

sentences.speaker: Oliver
sentences.text: Being able to hold a mug comfortably. I don't know how to judge whether I'm making progress.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Why not write that down and ask the therapist how progress will be assessed?

sentences.speaker: Oliver
sentences.text: I will. I'll take that question instead of trying to set my own deadline.
